policies.name: write-memory-only-from-the-memory-writer-runtime
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"write_memory", resource) when { context.actor == "memory-writer" };

policies.name: booking-for-a-person-from-the-booking-runtime
policies.code: permit(principal is User, action == Action::"book", resource) when { context.actor == "flight-booker" };

policies.name: reading-an-itinerary-for-a-person
policies.code: permit(principal is User, action == Action::"read_itinerary", resource) when { context.actor == "flight-booker" };

policies.name: the-seat-picker-acts-only-for-a-person
policies.code: permit(principal is User, action == Action::"pick_seat", resource) when { context.actor == "seat-picker" };

policies.name: anything-the-booking-agent-delegated-at-any-depth
policies.code: permit(principal is User, action == Action::"trace", resource) when { context.actor_chain.contains("flight-booker") };

tests.name: a traveller may cancel their own trip, whichever runtime acts
a different traveller may not cancel that trip
an agent subject is not the traveller
a call that names no subject is not the traveller either
write_memory is refused to a runtime that is not memory-writer
book is refused to a runtime that is not flight-booker
pick_seat is refused to a runtime that is not seat-picker
trace is refused outside the booking agent's delegation
the agent acting on its own behalf may warm the cache
the cache grant does not extend to a person subject
